analogy.literalString:
Imagine a **public ledger** shared by all students in a class.

Everyone has a copy of the ledger. If Xiao Ming lends 10 dollars to Xiao Hong, Xiao Ming shouts it out to the class, and all students record this transaction in their own ledgers. Because everyone has a record, no one can deny or tamper with the logs. This is the essence of a decentralized ledger (blockchain).
